method.authorizedChanges: Remove hoop/feet; recenter underside POSITION and recompute NORMAL only. Preserve all other component geometry, all non-spatial underside attributes, top join and depth.
method.suffixNormalization: Trailing .NNN Blender ID suffix is ignored for mesh matching only. Raw material names must exactly match baseline because the application uses exact names.
method.attributes: All exported vertex attributes per oriented triangle, transformed to world space where applicable; raw attribute digests also recorded
method.materials: Canonical PBR properties with resolved embedded image hashes and samplers; raw names checked independently

undersideCorrespondence.method: Compare oriented triangles after applying the exact declared depth-based float32 deformation to baseline world positions; compare every non-POSITION/NORMAL corner attribute on matching triangles.

sizingNote.heightReductionReason: Removal of the upright ornamental ring reduces maximum native Y from 1.7728016376495361 to 1.389304518699646. Underside recentering preserves depth and outer bounds.
